description: This file defines an interface for Sudo Search Commands within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifying methods and constants used for sudo commands related to thing search operations.

classes.name: ThingSearchSudoCommand
classes.description: A generic interface for all Sudo Search Commands in the Eclipse Ditto project, extending Command and WithIdButActuallyNot interfaces, providing constants and method signatures for resource handling.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer as required for Sudo Commands, indicating no specific resource path is needed.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the constant string 'thing-search-sudo' representing the resource type.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string used for Sudo commands, composed of a constant prefix and a qualifier.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command, allowing headers to be added to the command.
